import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create a sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "city": ["New York", "London", "Paris"]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory
bytes_buffer = BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(bytes_buffer)

# Get the bytes
parquet_bytes = bytes_buffer.getvalue()
print(f"\nParquet binary size: {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")

# Read back from bytes buffer
bytes_buffer.seek(0)
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(bytes_buffer)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Confirm round trip
assert df.frame_equal(df_restored), "DataFrames do not match!"
print("\n✓ Round trip successful - DataFrames are identical!")
